title: W01 to W06 Moderation Internal HTTP Binding

principal.layerSource: W02 canonical L0-L8 resolution consumed by W01

permission.source: Canonical moderation operation policy + permissions contract
permission.resolution: W01 calls the existing W08_CREATOR CASL endpoint using the canonical W02 session; W01 forwards the server-derived ALLOW decision bound to the fixed operation permission, resource type, policy version, subject, and layer; W06 validates those headers against its fixed operation map; browser clients cannot supply authoritative permission context.

reviewerScope.rule: A valid principal and L6 layer do not by themselves grant access outside the reviewer scope.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor userId and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers; body does not accept actor identity or ownership claims.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_order_created_{orderId}; one immutable D1-03 audit_events row per created W07 Order.
operations.idempotency: Event ID is stable across retries. W06 returns 200 only after confirming the same existing durable event and rejects conflicting immutable facts.
operations.successPolicy: W01 must validate the complete W07 Order DTO and must not return order-create success until W06 confirms event persistence or exact idempotent replay.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor userId and layer from the required W01 private transport headers; body cannot set actor identity.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_mpl_created_{planId}; one immutable D1-03 audit_events row per plan creation.
operations.idempotency: Event ID is stable across retries. W06 returns 200 only after confirming the same existing durable event.
operations.successPolicy: W01 must not return plan creation success unless W06 confirms event persistence or exact idempotent replay.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor identity and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers.
operations.idempotency: Stable event ID per lifecycle version; exact replay confirms immutable facts.
operations.successPolicy: W01 returns success only after W07 CAS and W06 final audit confirmation.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor identity and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers.
operations.idempotency: Exact semantic replay confirms durable intent; conflicting action/owner/version/state facts conflict.
operations.successPolicy: W01 must confirm durable lifecycle intent before invoking W07; missing audit prevents the mutation.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives the actor userId and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers; body cannot supply actor identity.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_mpl_published_{planId}_v{version}; one immutable D1-03 audit_events row per published plan version.
operations.idempotency: Stable event ID per plan/version; exact replay returns 200 only after confirming the same durable immutable event; changed facts conflict.
operations.successPolicy: W01 returns publish success only after W07 DTO validation and W06 durable audit confirmation. Missing audit confirmation fails closed.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor userId and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers; body cannot supply actor identity.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_mpl_publish_requested_{planId}_v{expectedVersion}; one immutable D1-03 event per owner-scoped publish attempt/version.
operations.idempotency: W06 generates occurredAt once. Exact semantic replay ignores only the newly generated attempt timestamp, confirms the same durable actor/target/before/after facts, and rejects conflicting facts.
operations.successPolicy: W01 must confirm the durable publish-request intent before invoking W07's D1-01 visibility transition. W06 failure prevents the plan from becoming public.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor identity and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers; request body cannot supply actor identity.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_mpl_updated_{planId}_v{version}; one immutable D1-03 audit per selected commercial plan version.
operations.idempotency: Stable event ID; exact immutable replay returns success, changed facts conflict.
operations.successPolicy: W01 only returns success after W07 DTO validation and durable W06 confirmation of the selected immutable plan version.

operations.actorAuthority: W06 derives actor identity and layer from trusted W01 private transport headers; request body cannot supply actor identity.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_mpl_update_requested_{planId}_{idempotencyKey}; one immutable D1-03 intent record per idempotent requested change.
operations.idempotency: Idempotency-Key is required. Same key with identical expected version and terms is an exact semantic replay; changed facts conflict. A different key permits a different request without mutating the prior intent.
operations.successPolicy: W01 must confirm this intent event before calling W07 to append a new immutable MembershipPlanVersion.

operations.actorAuthority: W07 returns the actor user ID and L2-L8 layer from the immutable OrderLine snapshot created during the W02-authenticated W01 checkout request. W01 accepts these facts only from its private W07 Service Binding response after a verified payment_succeeded event and successful D1-01 subscription CAS; provider request headers/body cannot set actor identity.
operations.eventId: Deterministic evt_spc_{changeRequestId}; one immutable D1-03 audit_events row for the paid Subscription plan change. Replayed provider callbacks reuse the same event ID and original appliedAt.
operations.idempotency: Stable event ID; W06 returns 200 only after confirming the same immutable actor, target, before/after versions, order/payment references and applied timestamp.
operations.successPolicy: W01 must confirm durable W06 audit persistence before acknowledging the Hyperswitch webhook. If W06 is unavailable, W01 returns 503; provider retry replays W07's D1-01 immutable plan-change receipt and retries the same W06 event.

principal.source: W01 verified principal; never public request body

failClosed: layer below L6 for moderation operations

security.trustBoundary: W06 is private and reachable only through the admitted W01 Service Binding.

nonGoals: No direct W02→W06 business Service Binding.
No runtime GREEN claim; deployment and security evidence remain required.
verificationRequirements: W01 source/unit proof for principal and layer forwarding
W06 source proof for server-derived permission and reviewer-scope checks
